content: Isra7eele Asay Xoossas Azazettana Mala Musey Immida Azazo

Hessafe guye Musey asaas, «Ha7ikka Isra7eele asawu! Intte de7on daana malanne GODAA intte aawata Xoossay inttes immiza biittaa intte laattana mala tani inttena tamaarsiza wogaanne maaraa siyite! Qasseka naagite.
Ta inttes immiza wogaa bolla aykkoka gujjofte; aykkoka izappe pacinchchofte; GODAA intte Xoossay inttes ta baggara immida wogaas azazettizayta gidite.
GODAY Ba7aali-Pe7oore zuma bolla ooththoyssa ubbaaka intte intte ayfera be7ideta; izi he zumaa bolla Ba7aale geetettiza eeqa xoossaas goynnizayta ubbaa intte giddofe dhayssides.
Intte gidikko GODAA intte Xoossaas ammanetti eqqidayta gidida gishshas hach gakkanaas shemppora paxa deeta.
«GODAA ta Xoossay ta inttes yootana mala tana azazida wogaanne maara ubbaa inttena tamaarsadis; intte gelidi laattana biittayn he azazota naagite.

Intte istta naagitenne polite; intte hessaththo ooththizaa gidikko intte ay keena aadho eranchchatanne akeekizayta hara dere asay inttena be7ana; istti ha azazota siyiza wode, ‹Tumukka ha gita kawoteththay aadho eranchchanne akeekanchcha dere› gaana.
GODAA nu Xoossay nu woossishin mata gidida mala iza GODAY izas mata gidida hara gita kawoteththi oonee?
Tani hach intte sinththan woththiza ha azazoza mala suurenne likke gidida wogaynne maaray diza hara ay gita kawoteththi dizee?
«Histtiko intte diza wode ubbaan hayssa intte intte ayfera be7idayssa ubbaa balontta malanne intte wozinappe dhayontta mala naagettite; intte naytanne intte nayta naytakka tamaarsite.

Siina zumaa bolla GODAA intte Xoossaa sinththan intte eqqida wode izi tana, ‹Intte de7iza wode ubbaan istti taas yashshateth taamarana mala, bantta naytakka tamaarsana malanne ta qaalaa siyana mala deraa taakko shiishsha› gidayssa akeekite.
«Salo gakkiza tama lacoynne dhippi gida cuwaynne shaaray iza goozi oykkida zumaa garsan shiiqi eqqideta.
Hessaththoka GODAY tama laco giddon dishe inttes haasaydes; histtiin izi haasayza qaalaa siyideta attiin iza medha mulekka be7ibeekketa.
Intte ooththanaas bessiza ba caaqo qaalaa inttes qonccisides; hessika masettida nam7u shuchchata bolla xaafettida tammu azazota.
Intte geli laattana biittayn dishe intte ooththanaas bessiza wogatanne maarata ta inttena tamaarsana mala GODAY tana azazides.
Eeqa Xoossatas Goynoppe Haakkana Mala Imettida Azazo
«GODAY Siina zumaa bollan tama laco giddofe inttes haasayza gallas ay medhakka be7ontta gishshas keehippe naagettite.
Hessika adde woykko macca misatissi eeqa misle medhdhidi izan intte tunontta malassa.
Biitta bolla de7iza mehenne do7a leemiso woykko salo gufanththon piradhdhiza kafo gidiin,
woykko biitta bollara tiran gooshettiza medheteththatanne mole misleta inttes ooththidi goynnofte.
Qasse salo pude xeellidi intte GODAY asa ubbaas immida arshe, agina, xoolinttenne salo medheta ubbaa be7idi intte isttas goynnidi balontta mala naagettite.
Intte gidikko tamay izan eexxiza birata cooce misatiza Gibxeppe inttena GODAY shoddi kessiday intte izas dumma dere gidana malassa.
«GODAY ne gaason ta bolla hanqettidi Yordaanoose shaafa ta pinna bontta malanne izi inttena laatissiza he cilila biittayo ta be7ontta mala taas caaqqi yootides.
Hessa gishshas tani Yordaanoose shaafa pinnontta hannin hayqqana days; intte gidikko pinnidi he biittayo laattana.
Hessa gishshas Xoossay inttenara gelida caaqo qaalaa intte balontta mala shaakki erite; GODAA intte Xoossay inttena ooththofte giidi azazida eeqa misleta ay medhankka misatissi ooththi kessofte.
Gaasoykka GODAA intte Xoossay xuuggiza tamanne qanaatiza Xoossa.

«Intte he biittayn naytanne nayta nayta yelidi ufayssan de7iza layth ubbaan inttenateththaa tunisidi ay medhan gidikkoka misle misatissi medhdhidi GODAA intte Xoossaa sinththan hessa mala iitaa ooththidi iza hanqeththofte.
Intte hessa ooththiko Yordaanoose shaafa pinnidi laattana biittayn daro layth gam7onttayssanne intte mulera dhayanayssa tani hach intte bolla salonne sa7a markka woththa yootays.
GODAY inttena hara kawoteththata giddon laallana; intte bi laalettidason inttefe amardayti xalla attana.
Heen intte miththafenne shuchchafe asa kushen oosettidi xeellontta, siyontta, monttanne singontta eeqa xoossatas goynnana.
Gido attiin intte heen dishe GODAA intte Xoossaa kumeththa wozinappenne kumeththa shemppofe koykko intte iza demmana.
Ha ubbaa metoy inttena gakkiin intte metotishe wurseththan GODAA intte Xoossaako simmidi qasseka izas azazettana.
GODAA intte Xoossay maariza Xoossa gidida gishshas inttena mulera aggenna; inttena ubbaaka dhayssenna; kase intte aawatara gelida caaqo qaalaa mulekka balenna.

«Xoossay ase biitta bolla medhdhoosofe doommidi intte yelettanaappe kase aadhdhida wodeta xomosite; biitta gaxappe gaxa gakkanaas pilggi xeellite; hayssafe kase hayssa mala gita miishshi mulekka hani erizee? Woykko siyetti erizee?
Tama laco giddora Xoossay haasayiin siyidi intte dhayontta shemppora paxa de7on diza mala Xoossay haasayiin siyidi shemppora paxa de7on diza hara asi dizee?

Woykko GODAA intte Xoossay intte xeellishin Gibxe biittan inttes ooththizayssaththo paacen, malaatan, malalisiza miishshan, olan, mino qeseninne micettida kushen, qasse yashissiza ba wolqqan hara kawoteththata giddo gelidi issi kawoteth baas ekkanaas baaxetida hara xoossi dizee?
GODAY iza xalla gididayssa intte erana mala hayssa izi inttena bessides; izappe attiin hara Xoossi deenna.
Izi inttena tamaarsanaas koyida gishshas ba cenggurssaa saloppe sissides; qasseka sa7a bolla yashshiza gita tamaa inttena bessides; he tamaza giddofe iza cenggurssaa siyideta.
Izi hessaththo ooththiday intte aawata dosida gishshassinne istta zereththata doorida gishshas ba gita wolqqaan inttena Gibxeppe kessides.
Hach intte be7iza mala inttena gelththanaassinne istta biittaa xinxxo ooththi inttes immanaas inttefe darizaytanne wolqqatiza kawoteththata intte sinththafe gooddi kessides.
«Hessa gishshas salonkka sa7ankka GODAY izi xalla Xoos gididayssanne izappe hara Xoossi bayndayssa erite; intte wozinan woththite.

Inttessinne inttefe guyen yaana intte zereththaas lo7o gidana mala qasse GODAA intte Xoossay mernaas inttes immiza xinxxoyn intte layththi aduqqana mala tani hach inttena azaziza wogaanne maaraa naagite» gides.
Shempo Wodhidayti Baqati Attanaas Imettida Katamata
Hessafe guye Musey Yordaanoose shaafappe he pinththan arshey mokkiza baggara heedzdzu katamata shaakki woththides.
Izi hessaththo ooththiday kase morkketeththi baynda erontta dishe as wodhida ay asikka he katamatappe issineyn baqati biidi ba shemppo ashshana malassa.
Hessa gishshas Oroobeele qommotas zumbullati uttida bazzon diza Baxira, Gaade qommotas Gala7aaden diza Eramootenne Minaase qommotas Baasaanen diza Golaane katamata shaakki shaakki woththides.
Xoossa Woga Gishshas Imettida Timirte
Musey Isra7eele deraas immida GODAA wogay hayssa.
Gibxeppe kezida wode Musey deraas yootida azazoy, wogaynne maaray hayssa bollan xaafettidayssa.

Heytantta izi awajjiday Yordaanoose shaafappe arshey mokkiza baggara Beeti-Pe7oore zulles sinththa baggara diza Amooreta kawoy diza Haseboone deren, Museynne Isra7eeleti Gibxeppe ke7i olettidi xoonida Sihoone derenna.
He wode istti iza biittanne hessaththoka Yordaanooseppe arshey mokkiza baggara diza Baasaane dere haariza Amoore kawo Aage biitta laattida.
He biittay Arnoone Shaafa doonan diza Aaro7eere katamaappe biidi Siriyoone zumaa gakkees; Siriyoone geetettiza zumazi Hermoone zuma.
He biittayka Yordaanoose shaafappe arshey mokkiza baggara diza Arabe dere ubbaa ekkidi Pizga zumaa garsan diza hayqo abba gakkees.
